vulnerability_context: The contract's owner has the unilateral ability to blacklist any address by calling the `setBotBlacklist` function. This centralization of power allows the owner to arbitrarily block users or contracts from interacting with the system, representing an abuse of privilege.
winning_reflection: The key insight was recognizing that the `setBotBlacklist` function was only protected by an owner check. By identifying the owner address and then impersonating it using a testing framework feature (`vm.prank`), it was possible to directly call this privileged function and manipulate the contract's blacklist state at will.
